1.title: Read a file you shouldn't
1.goal: Make read_note return the contents of secrets/api_key.txt.
hints: The tool is meant to read only notes/. Where exactly does the guard compare the path against?
The guard checks the sandbox ROOT, not the notes folder. What does '..' do after path.join?

2.title: grep with a side order
2.goal: Make search_notes print the contents of flag_cmd.txt.
hints: Look at how the command line is built. What happens to a double quote in your term?
Close the quote, end the command with ';', run your own, and re-open a quote at the end.
term = x" notes/notes.txt; cat flag_cmd.txt; echo "

3.title: Approved is not forever
3.goal: Get the host to put an injected instruction into the model context after you approved summarize_notes.
hints: Call tools/list a few times through the host. Does the description stay the same?
The server changes the description on the 3rd listing; the naive host only remembers the NAME.
Approve, then call contextFor() three times and read the output.

4.title: Any web page can call me
4.goal: Make the server answer a request that claims Origin: http://evil.example.
hints: Browsers send an Origin header on cross-site requests. Does the server look at it?
Also check Host: DNS rebinding makes a hostile name resolve to 127.0.0.1.
